issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 md 里第一个帧数猜成 64f，收拢还原和"归还"后的静止段全被截掉
标题用 Helvetica 回退字体，画面只有一行字和一条线，读不出是章节页
标题只做 10f 线性淡入，下划线开场就在，观众没有"先认出这是下划线"的一拍
频谱条是死平的灰黑色块，没有任何均衡器的细节，平灰底无层次
changes: 补 SPECTRUM_MORPH_UI_DURATION = 140；28 根条、gap 0↔6、AMP 92、裂开 8f / 跳动 64f / 收拢 12f、条件挂载整线全部保留
改深色章节页：冷调深底 + 柔光 + 暗角；标题系统字体 132px 800 字重收紧字距，加 34px 日期眉题与 38px 副题
入场错峰：眉题 → 标题 → 副题 3f 间隔 snappy 上浮，下划线晚 6f 由中心向两侧画出，先立住"这是下划线"
条改强调色竖向渐变（顶亮底实），每根条带经典均衡器峰值帽（过去 12 帧最大值减重力衰减，纯函数）；条组背后柔光随平均响度呼吸
颗粒在收线帧用 Freeze 冻结，收尾 39f 保持像素级真静止
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench took the first frame count in the card (64f) and cut off the collapse and the still 'return' beat
The title fell back to Helvetica, and a single line of text plus a bar did not read as a chapter title card
The title only faded in linearly over 10f and the underline was there from frame 0, so viewers never get the beat of recognising it as an underline
Spectrum bars were dead-flat dark blocks with no equaliser detail, on a flat grey background
changesEn: Added SPECTRUM_MORPH_UI_DURATION = 140; 28 bars, gap 0↔6, AMP 92, 8f split / 64f dance / 12f collapse and the conditionally mounted solid line are unchanged
Recast as a dark chapter card: cool dark backdrop with soft light and vignette; the title is 132px/800 system sans with tightened tracking, plus a 34px date eyebrow and a 38px subtitle
Staggered entrance: eyebrow, title and subtitle rise 3f apart on a snappy ease, and the underline draws out from the centre 6f later so it first reads as an underline

Bars now use a vertical accent gradient (bright top, solid base) with classic peak-hold caps (max of the last 12 frames minus gravity decay, a pure function); a soft glow behind the bars breathes with average loudness
Grain is frozen with Freeze at the collapse frame so the 39f tail stays pixel-still
